rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that only one thing, person, or material is involved.
Use this when the exclusivity means that access, eligibility, or application is restricted to a named group or category.

example.english: This offer is exclusively for members.
example.traditional: 呢個優惠只限於會員享用。
